status: QUALIFIED SPECIFICATION - NOT A FROZEN COHORT, NO OUTCOMES EXIST

POSITIVE.condition: record_status == VALID AND net_return_frac_14d > 0 (exact rational comparison)

NEGATIVE.condition: record_status == VALID AND net_return_frac_14d <= 0 (zero is NOT positive; boundary exclusive on positivity)

UNTESTED.condition: record_status in {UNRESOLVED, INSUFFICIENT_DATA} or pool failed to complete maturity with readable state

INVALID.condition: record_status == INVALID (hash mismatch, identity failure, post-hoc modification)

run_level.EDGE_CONFIRMED: min evidence met AND edge_frac > 0 AND exact one-sided Fisher p < 5/100
run_level.EDGE_NOT_ESTABLISHED: min evidence met AND edge_frac > 0 AND p >= 5/100 (honest absence-of-demonstration; NOT proof of no edge)
run_level.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: VALID observations per arm < MIN_VALID_PER_ARM (fail closed)
run_level.INVALID_RUN: any integrity gate failure: contract hash mismatch, malformed genesis hash, duplicate pool id, role conflict, bad role/status, non-finite metric

primary_metric.per_observation: net_return_frac_14d from economic contract v1.1 section 16 (exact Fraction; integer inputs; single final division)
primary_metric.significance: one-sided Fisher exact tail P(X >= a | m=10, n=10, K=a+c), computed in exact integer/rational arithmetic

minimum_evidence.rationale: cohort is exactly 10 TOP + 10 CONTROL; reserves resolve pre-genesis deaths only; post-genesis shortfalls fail closed rather than dilute the denominator
minimum_evidence.asymmetric_completion: either arm below minimum -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for the whole run
minimum_evidence.missing_outcome: UNTESTED observation -> counts against minimum evidence
minimum_evidence.invalid_outcome_record: INVALID observation -> INVALID_RUN when integrity-related; otherwise counts against minimum evidence

boundary_semantics.positivity: strictly greater than 0; net == 0 classifies NEGATIVE (documented exclusive boundary)
boundary_semantics.alpha: p < 5/100 strictly; p == 5/100 does NOT confirm
boundary_semantics.rounding: all comparisons on unrounded exact rationals; display rounding occurs only after verdict assignment

missing_and_invalid_data_rules.endpoint_disagreement: INVALID + halt per economic contract section 10
missing_and_invalid_data_rules.block_hash_mismatch: INVALID + halt per economic contract section 11

deterministic_serialization.input_canonicalization: observations sorted by (lowercase pool_id, role); nets serialized as exact 'num/den' strings; JSON sort_keys, separators without whitespace; UTF-8
deterministic_serialization.output: result dict JSON sort_keys; SHA256 recorded per run

provenance_requirements: every record embeds economic_contract_sha256 and cohort manifest hash
resolver must refuse records whose embedded hashes differ from prereg-committed values (3C section 18 rule 2)
no arm labels enter the calculator input schema beyond role membership required for aggregation
acceptance_standard_sha256: RECORDED IN docs/reports/OP-MC-PREMATURITY_3G_ACCEPTANCE_STANDARD_QUALIFICATION.md section A (self-referential hash cannot be embedded)
